Colours for populations and super-populations

Source: R/palettes.R
colours.Rd

Named vectors of colours used by all snpscaper plots. Use them in your own plots, for example with ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(values = superpop_colours), or pass them to factoextra: factoextra::fviz_pca_ind(pca, habillage = "super_pop", palette = superpop_colours).

Usage

superpop_colours

pop_colours

Format

Named character vectors of hex colour codes.

Details

  • superpop_colours: one colour for each of the five super-populations.

  • pop_colours: one colour for each of the 26 populations, in shades of their super-population colour.

Examples

superpop_colours
#>       AFR       AMR       EAS       EUR       SAS 
#> "#E69F00" "#D55E00" "#009E73" "#0072B2" "#CC79A7" 
head(pop_colours)
#>       ACB       ASW       ESN       GWD       LWK       MSL 
#> "#996900" "#B27B00" "#CC8D00" "#E69F00" "#EAB02E" "#EEC25D"
